intro.speaker: pops
intro.text: Alright rookie, I need a thingy jiggy. Put these two pieces together, tack 'em, and weld 'em. Don't waste my wire.

assemblyHint.speaker: pops
assemblyHint.text: Drag the plate around, spin it with the arrows. Line it up like the print says.

incorrectAssembly.speaker: pops
incorrectAssembly.text: That's crooked as a dog's hind leg. Line it up again before I lose my patience.

tackingHint.speaker: pops
tackingHint.text: Two tacks on the corners. Little ones. We ain't building a battleship.

missedTack.speaker: pops
missedTack.text: You strike an arc before tacking and that joint'll walk right off the table. Tack it first!

grindingHint.speaker: pops
grindingHint.text: Clean the joint. Grinder's the only tool that makes a bad welder look good.

skippedGrind.speaker: pops
skippedGrind.text: Welding over mill scale? Grind that seam clean, rookie.

executionHint.speaker: pops
executionHint.text: Dial in your volts and wire, then run that bead nice and steady.

badWeld.speaker: pops
badWeld.text: That bead looks like a chicken scratched it. Grind it out and do it again.

success.speaker: pops
success.text: Huh. Ain't half bad. Don't let it go to your head, rookie.

levelFailed.speaker: pops
levelFailed.text: Go home. Come back when you've grown some thicker skin.
